reaction_identification.literature_precedent: Diaryliodonium salts are well-established electrophilic aryl-transfer reagents for O/N/S-arylation. Tosylhydrazones are known to fragment under basic conditions to diazo species with expulsion of p-toluenesulfinate; sulfinates are known to undergo S-arylation with diaryliodonium salts to give aryl sulfones. N-arylation/cyclization sequences from hydrazone/diazo intermediates to pyrazoles are precedented, though the exact substrate-dependent cyclization pathway can vary.
